artworks.title: The Hand as the Mirror of Salvation
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in rose, green, yellow and gray; printed by friction in brown ink
artworks.dimensions:
image: 38.5 x 26.5 cm (15 3/16 x 10 7/16 in.)
sheet: 39.1 x 27 cm (15 3/8 x 10 5/8 in.)
overall (exterior frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a print of a hand with detailed annotations and accompanying illustrations. The hand is the central focus, with inscriptions on each finger. Two small people are on either side of the hand, both dressed in robes with round yellow halos behind their heads. The person on the left appears to shake something held up by their head, with a jar beside them. The person on the right is holding a long object connected to a wolf or dog covered in green paint, and in the other hand they hold a small bucket. Latin text is on scroll-like banners surrounding the hand. Longer blocks of text fill the spaces around the hand and figures.

artworks.title: The Way of Salvation
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in green, yellow, red lake, blue, brown, and orange (border)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 26.2 x 18 cm (10 5/16 x 7 1/16 in.)
sheet: 26.9 x 18.8 cm (10 9/16 x 7 3/8 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of an allegorical scene featuring a pathway leading to virtues, set against a natural and ornate backdrop. The image illustrates a central path made up of steps that are labeled in German, with each step representing a different virtue such as love, humility, and justice. This path leads upwards to a sacred or celestial realm, with angelic figures at the top surrounded by clouds. On either side of the path, the landscape is filled with colorful foliage and symbolic elements, such as a heart and various plants. Scrolls and banners unfurl alongside the scene contain text. This is in the style of Albrecht Dürer, exhibiting detail and moralistic symbolism.

artworks.title: Calendar with the Nativity and Adoration
artworks.description: This is a page with intricate illustrations and German text. There are two woodcut-style illustrations at the top featuring religious imagery surrounded by symbolic elements. Below the illustrations, the page is filled with dense text in a Gothic typeface, with large ornate initial letters beginning paragraphs. The print has an antique aesthetic, suggesting its origins from an early modern text, likely related to religious or historical events.

artworks.title: Initial A and a New Year's Wish
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in olive green, rose, orange, green, brown, and yellow-green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an illuminated manuscript page featuring a large decorative initial, ornate borders and flourishes, and text in a Gothic script. The initial letter is an ornamental "A," filled with intricate vine and leaf patterns, bordered by lines. Above the text, a ribbon decorated with an illustration of a figure and another motif contains a title or heading written in a slender cursive style. The surrounding areas are lightly decorated with botanical elements, and the text is carefully lined and structured across the page. The paper shows some signs of aging.

artworks.title: Miracle at Seefeld
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, blue, yellow, purple, brown, gray, and lavender
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene in a church. The image features an altar setting with ornate columns and detailed architectural elements. Elements such as figures robed in religious vestments and others in colorful garments suggest figures participating in a ceremonial act. The painting includes a checkerboard floor and textile patterns. The church's interior is enhanced by banners, stained glass windows, and a gothic altar. The painting reflects stylistic elements reminiscent of the medieval or Gothic artistic tradition.

artworks.title: Allegory of the Eagle and Emperor Maximilian I
artworks.description: The image depicts a printed page with ornate medieval illustrations and Latin text. The central illustration shows an eagle holding a scroll, surrounded by floral motifs and heraldic elements, including a shield with a double-headed eagle. Flanking the central image are smaller panels: on the left, a cherubic figure stands with animals, and below it, a lion's head encircled by Baroque flourishes and the text "S S M A R C V S"; on the right, an angelic figure appears above a bull's head with the text "S L V C A S". The text below the images is in Latin script, spread in a multi-column format with decorative capital letters. The illustrations incorporate detailed line work typical of Renaissance woodcut prints.

artworks.title: A Warning Against Playing Dice
artworks.description: The image shows a medieval scene with an aerial perspective looking down on a castle landscape. The horizon is in the middle with fortified walls, towers, and structures across rolling hills. Buildings, walls, a windmill, and more structures are depicted in the distance. The hills slope upwards towards more architectural elements on elevated terrain. The style resembles engravings or woodcuts with bold, thick lines and a monochrome color palette of black and white. Two riders on horses appear engaged in an activity, with detailed costumes and armor. Curved lines add texture to the horses and figures, while wavy lines suggest foliage.

artworks.title: Bookplate of Wilhelm von Zell
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper mounted on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic emblem with accompanying Latin script. The drawing features two distinct coats of arms. On the left, a shield with swirling patterns is topped by a knight's helmet, adorned with heraldic mantling and a small embellishment. To the right, the shield displays three diagonal stripes and is surmounted by a depiction of an imaginary creature, akin to a dragon or griffin, adorned with heraldic decoration. The entire scene is framed within a simple black border, set against a plain background. Below the illustration, a line of Latin text in elegant script is visible.

artworks.title: Bookplate of Hilprand Brandenburg of Bibrach
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, rose, light blue, red, and yellow on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a winged figure holding a shield featuring a bull. The image portrays a figure with green and red wings, dressed in a flowing robe, holding a blue shield with both hands. The shield prominently displays a drawing of a bull with distinctive horns and an energetic stance. The figure has flowing golden hair and stylized facial features typical of medieval or early renaissance artwork. The colors are vibrant, with an emphasis on earth tones and contrast between the shield and the figure's robe. This is in the style of medieval woodcut prints.

artworks.title: Bookplate of Hilprand Brandenburg of Bibrach
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, rose, light blue, red, and yellow on laid paper, mounted on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a heraldic shield held by an angelic figure. The image shows an angelic figure dressed in a long robe with wings spread wide behind it. The wings are colored in shades of green, contrasting against the earthy tone of the robe. The face of the figure is designed with simple lines giving it a serene expression. The angel is holding a blue shield emblazoned with the image of a bull or an ox. The bull is depicted in a contrasting light color against the blue of the shield. The style is reminiscent of a medieval woodcut illustration.

artworks.title: Gerson as Pilgrim with Town in Background
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with a staff in one hand and a shield with a sun face and stars in the other. He has curly hair, a beard, and is dressed in layered garments, a cloak, stockings, and shoes. A small dog stands beside him. The background includes hills, a tree, and a castle with towers and walls.

artworks.title: Gerson as Pilgrim
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a traveler with a dog in a medieval setting. The traveler is carrying a bundle of sticks on their back, standing on the ground with stylized flora. They are holding a staff and accompanied by a small dog. In the background, there is a castle on a hill. The drawing predominantly uses line work with red accents highlighting certain features, such as plants and clothing. The scene is framed by intricate designs.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion with Saint Mary Magdalene
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a crucifixion scene set in a cityscape. The central figure on a cross with an inscription "INRI" above is adorned with a crown of thorns and visible wounds. Surrounding the central figure are robed figures in various colors positioned around the cross. In the background, there is a detailed landscape with green fields, a town with buildings including what appears to be a castle and a church with red rooftops. A small hill with trees and a winding path are also visible. The style is similar to the detailed woodcuts and engravings of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures around a crucifixion scene. The central figure is nailed to the cross with arms outstretched, wearing a crown of thorns and a cloth around the waist. To the left, a woman stands with her hands clasped, wearing a blue robe and a white headdress. On the right, a young man with long hair stands in a red robe over a gray tunic, with his hands clasped. The background shows a simple landscape with hills and a muted blue sky. Near the base of the cross, there are skull and bones.

artworks.title: Madonna of the Hernleberg
artworks.medium: woodcut printed in orange on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures in a detailed illustration. The central figure is standing and holding a smaller figure, likely a child, in their arms. The larger figure wears a crown and has a serene expression. The hair flows down in soft curves, typical of classical depictions. The clothing is long and flowing. Rays emanate from the central figures. A smaller figure on their knees is positioned towards the larger figures. The background includes architectural elements like a chapel with a cross and natural elements like trees.

artworks.title: Madonna of the Hernleberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene. The image depicts a crowned figure holding a child, surrounded by radiating lines and clouds, set against a hilly landscape with a church and buildings. There's text, including "HERNLEBERG," at the top and a scroll reading "ORA PRO NOBIS 1794" along with additional text below. The artwork is detailed with elements suggesting a narrative, possibly of pilgrimage or devotion, showcased through symbolic imagery like the dove at the top left corner.

artworks.title: Title Page for Callot's "The Small Miseries of War"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate frame with a central text block. The frame is elaborately decorated with intricate scrollwork, stylized flames or waves, and a scaly texture at the top. The central text is in French, referencing the artist Jacques Callot and the year 1636. The calligraphic text adds to the period charm of the drawing, suggesting a formal or commemorative purpose.

artworks.title: Christ as Salvator Mundi
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in yellow and red
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a standing figure. The person is positioned facing forward with their head slightly tilted and both hands held in front of their chest. The facial features are defined with a prominent beard and long, wavy hair that reaches past the shoulders. The individual is wearing a long robe that drapes down to the feet, which are bare. The robe has intricate patterns and details on it. In one hand, the person holds an orb topped with a small cross, while the other hand is raised in a gesture. The background is decorated with detailed, floral or vine-like patterns and contains text in a Gothic style script along the borders.

artworks.title: Franciscan, Pelbartus of Temesvar, in a Garden
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a monk writing in a garden under a tree. The central image shows a monk writing at a wooden lectern in a garden, surrounded by lush vegetation. Decorative circular medallions with symbolic creatures are depicted above and below the main image. The background features Gothic-style text. The illustration follows a medieval style with a religious or scholarly theme.

artworks.title: Bishop of Augsburg with Three Coats of Arms
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing upright. The person is positioned facing forward, with one hand raised in a gesture and the other hand holding a long golden staff with an ornate top. The figure has prominent facial features, depicted with linear details, and the person's hair is not visible as they are wearing a tall red and white mitre adorned with blue and green gems. Their clothing is a rich brown robe draped over a blue garment with white sleeves visible, featuring jewel-like red accents on the cuffs. The figure is surrounded by a decorative frame with floral motifs at the top. At the bottom, there are two heraldic shields, one red and white and the other black and white, resting on a green background. There is no visible background behind the figure, as it is set against a cream-colored backdrop.

artworks.title: Friedrich Count of Schaumberg - Bishop of Salzburg
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a figure dressed in ornate religious attire. The person is seated behind a large heraldic shield featuring a black lion on a yellow background on the left and red stripes on the right. The individual is holding an open book in their left hand and a decorative crosier in their right hand. They are wearing a mitre adorned with red and yellow patterns on their head. Their hair is gray and appears to be styled in short curls on the sides. The face is shown with mature, slightly wrinkled features. Their clothing includes a richly patterned blue robe with a red vestment adorned with a large jeweled medallion at the center. The background is simple, featuring grass and small plants at the bottom, with a gradient sky above.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in a religious scene. The central figure is on a wooden cross, with a crown of thorns, a halo behind the head, expressive facial features, a beard, and long hair. The body is covered with a cloth around the waist. To the left, a figure stands in a blue robe with arms crossed and a halo. To the right, another figure in a green garment and red cloak reaches out towards the central figure, holding a book, and with a halo. The background is a blue sky, with green ground, stones, and a skull underfoot. There is a scroll with lettering above the figures and additional text at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: The image shows three figures against a detailed backdrop. The central figure is positioned slightly turned to the left with long, flowing golden hair and a prominent halo. They wear a brown robe with red undertones. Behind them is a person with a beard and a sea-green hat. A small figure resembling a cherubic infant lies surrounded by golden rays. In the stable setting, two animals, likely a donkey and an ox, are depicted. The background shows a rustic stable with geometric designs. Above, an angelic figure with a halo and wings hovers. The image is bordered by an intricate frame with stars and circular symbols.
